zh-CN.title: 知识中心
zh-CN.description: 在独立页面浏览知识空间、导入资料，并查看文档处理状态。

usage.title: 选择空间与知识库
usage.description: 打开知识中心，选择你有权限访问的空间及其中的知识库。

usage.title: 导入资料
usage.description: 按页面提供的操作导入文件、网址或文本。可用按钮取决于你的权限和服务支持。

usage.title: 查看处理状态
usage.description: 检查返回的文档记录或按文档标识查询状态，必要时手动刷新。

requirements: 已安装并启用知识空间与连接、知识入库与处理扩展，并为你分配可访问的空间和资源。

en-US.title: Knowledge center
en-US.description: Browse knowledge spaces, import content and inspect document processing on a dedicated page.

usage.title: Choose a space and knowledge base
usage.description: Open Knowledge center and select an accessible space and mapped knowledge base.

usage.title: Import content
usage.description: Use the available controls to import a file, URL or text. Controls depend on your permissions and provider support.

usage.title: Inspect processing
usage.description: Inspect the returned document record or look up a document by ID, refreshing its status when needed.

requirements: Enable the knowledge platform and management extensions and grant you access to spaces and resources.
